text:
aditi: Heads up — today's release window is blocked. Canary smoke stage failing on artifact fetches; CI spikes 429s from our artifact registry and a bunch of ephemeral runners are getting killed for OOM. deploy-bot auto-paused the promotion.

ops-bot: :alert: Canary promotion paused by deploy-bot: artifact_fetch_rate_limited (registry returned 429). Manual intervention required.

tom-w: Logs from the failing job: ```
[2026-02-12T09:10:12Z] Fetching artifact: f5a7b2...
[2026-02-12T09:10:12Z] ERROR: registry: rate limit exceeded (429)
[2026-02-12T09:10:13Z] Retrying fetch (attempt 3)...
[2026-02-12T09:10:15Z] RunnerOOM: process killed by OOM killer
[2026-02-12T09:10:15Z] stack: smoke_test.startup -> setup_env -> pull_artifacts -> read_blob -> CacheClientError(read timeout)
```

aditi: Repro notes: when parallel fetches >=8 we see registry 429s and retry storms. Retries chew memory on the ephemeral runner and push it over.

qa-lead: We can either (A) pin the release to yesterday's known-good `f5a7b2` and promote manually, or (B) lower concurrency + add exponential backoff in the registry client and attempt re-run. Which do we prefer for this change window?

release-manager: Short term = unblock customers. Pin+manual promote to `f5a7b2`. Medium term = reduce concurrency, add client backoff and circuit breaker, and increase runner memory for smoke. Create tickets and assign.

aditi: Agree. I'll prepare the manual promote steps. Also adding a temporary pipeline env override: `ARTIFACT_FETCH_PARALLELISM=3`. That should reduce the registry pressure while we investigate.

tom-w: Will open tickets: ARTREG-77 (backoff + circuit breaker), CI-998 (reduce default parallelism), RUNNERS-210 (increase ephemeral runner memory).

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested: artifact=f5a7b2 -> env=production. Awaiting operator confirmation.

aditi: Manual promote commands (ops runbook):
```
# validate artifact in staging
cictl run smoke --artifact f5a7b2 --env staging
# promote to prod from ops account
deploy-bot promote --artifact f5a7b2 --env production --by @aditi --note "pin to last-known-good due to registry 429 OOMs"
# rollback if needed
deploy-bot rollback --previous
```

qa-lead: I'll run the staging smoke now with the lowered parallelism. Posting results in a minute.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Staging smoke completed: 6/6 tests passed on artifact f5a7b2 at 1760056845 with ARTIFACT_FETCH_PARALLELISM=3.

aditi: Proceeding with manual promote.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Promote succeeded for artifact f5a7b2 to production at 1760056855.

tom-w: Production canary metrics: fetch error rate dropped from 18% -> 0.5% in first 10m after promote; runner OOMs stopped. Will leave monitoring for 1 hour.

release-manager: Decision logged: pin to f5a7b2 and manual promote. Followups created: ARTREG-77, CI-998, RUNNERS-210. Controlled canary: 60m. If errors reappear reopen this thread.

aditi: Thanks all. I'll write up a short retro and add the deploy commands + notes to the release notes. Closing thread once followups are triaged. :memo:
